name: Soap Film
desc: A soap membrane stretched across the lens, computed as real thin-film interference — fringe colour comes from optical path length, so the film drains under gravity, the bands crowd and sink, a black spot opens where it goes molecularly thin at x/y, and after about a minute it ruptures and reforms; additive and self-dimming, so it iridesces over a scene without swamping it.

energy.doc: marangoni churn amplitude + fringe contrast + sheen

density.doc: film thickness — how many interference orders crowd into the frame

scale.doc: size of the convection cells (and of the bubble in 'bubble' style)

alpha.doc: reflection strength — additive and hard-capped, so 1 still will not blow out the scene

hue.doc: rotates the whole interference palette off its physical colours

x.doc: drain origin X — where the black spot opens and the rupture starts ('bubble' style: bubble centre)

y.doc: drain origin Y — top of frame is the physical default

style.doc: aesthetic: flat draining membrane over the whole lens / curved bubble wall, fringes bowing into the rim under a specular cap / interference order quantised to flat inks with hard contour lines, printed not optical / single sodium wavelength, monochrome lab fringes

act.doc: dramaturgy: thins for a minute, ruptures, reforms / stable film that only churns, never pops / thickness pumps against the musical arc so fringes race in and out

seed.doc: churn phases + where in the drain cycle it starts
